question: Why could the serpent king not remain in his own realm during the rainy season?
premises: The serpent king was stupefied by a poison-born sleep.
This condition arose from the churning of the milk ocean.
During the rainy season he could not remain in his own realm.
inference: The pavitraka narrative begins with the serpent king's affliction and displacement from his realm.
plain_english: The serpent king, stupefied by a poison-born sleep from the churning of the milk ocean, could not remain in his own realm during the rainy season.
